bare.note: Strongest is the honest NULL-counting completeness metric; weakest is LAG(System.Timestamp(), 1) as an event-time source plus a misalignment metric resting on a direction convention it concedes it guessed.

spec.note: Strongest is the wave-height comparison across two disjoint PT20M supports with the elapsed time verified rather than assumed; weakest is that the load-bearing LAG offset of 4 is a dialect feature it could not confirm.
